notes:
Snapshot: mid-size APAC contact center provider focused on enterprise telco + fintech accounts. Heavy multilingual load (EN, ZH, JA, ID, HI, TL). Primarily real-time chat + voice->ASR->NLU pipeline for agents. Interested in a hybrid deployment: VPC for cloud region with an on-prem stub for PII-heavy operations.

Key technical requirements (shorthand):
- P95 token latency <= 150ms APAC peak (chat agent assist).
- Batch summarization for tickets (<10s SLA) and high-accuracy tone adaptation per locale.
- Regional routing by legal jurisdiction + language.
- Tool-calling: CRM writebacks, ticket create/update, and live transfer to human flows (webhook + idempotency guarantees).
- Graceful degradation path: fallback to smaller local quantized model on capacity spikes.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML) + enterprise KMS.
- Retention controls and audit logs required for 7+ years for certain telco clients.
- Data residency: prefer Singapore & Tokyo cloud regions, with option for on-prem enclave for regulated customers.

Commercial: looking for committed throughput pricing for Dedicated or Private; willing to sign 12–24 month reserve if performance SLAs met. Procurement roadmap: PO signed after POC metrics pass and security checklist closed.

Quote from CTO Wei Zhang (paraphrase): "If we can't guarantee APAC p95 during our evening surge, the contract won't fly — latency is non-negotiable."
summary_requirements: Customer needs a production-grade inference stack that can handle multilingual real-time agent assist and high-volume ticket summarization with strict APAC latency SLAs, strong residency and audit controls, and routing by locale/jurisdiction. Priorities: latency, residency, deterministic fallbacks during spikes, and CRM/tool integration reliability.
poc_details: POC plan (proposed): 4 weeks. Week 1: deploy Dedicated pool in SG region + VPC peering. Week 2: integrate websocket chat + tool-calls (ticket create/update). Week 3: run synthetic surge tests (2x, 5x baseline) to validate batching and fallback behavior. Week 4: measure metrics vs SLA (p95 latency, token cost), run security checklist. Success criteria: p95 <= 150ms under 2x baseline, ticket summarization accuracy >= 88%, zero dropped webhook calls, SOC2 docs provided.
